changes: Fixed SRT-to-SDI routes reconnecting on sources that omit framerate metadata: the SDI output now infers the video framerate, so those streams no longer interrupt the route.
Live Preview on SRT-to-SDI routes now reuses the SDI decoder instead of decoding the stream a second time, substantially reducing CPU use on those routes.
Live Preview thumbnails no longer freeze on sources without periodic keyframes; previews now refresh about once per second regardless of GOP structure.
Fixed Live Preview aborting the pipeline on some AVC/H.264 sources; HEVC previews remain rate-limited and stable.
Destination statistics now attribute connected clients to the correct output and report send rate and round-trip time for listener destinations.
Improved SDI output resilience during source changes: the black fallback now engages only once the selector is linked, preventing a pipeline error that could interrupt the route.
